name: Sky Events
description: Dates and times for events in the sky that people put on a calendar: solar and lunar eclipses, full moons and their traditional names, meteor shower peaks, equinoxes and solstices. Stories give the date and time in Eastern Time with a note on other US time zones, say where in North America the event can be seen, and cite NASA, the US Naval Observatory or another official source for every time given. Each piece links to the monthly printable calendar for that month so the event can be written in ahead of the night.
